title: dodecatheon conjugens subsp. leptophyllum
intro: Dodecatheon conjugens subsp. leptophyllum, commonly known as the western tiger lily or yellow pond-lily, is a perennial plant species belonging to the primrose family (Primulaceae). It is known for its yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Dodecatheon conjugens subsp. leptophyllum include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
